questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of farming that involves the cultivation of high-value crops such as vegetables, fruits, and flowers for urban markets?
questions.solution: Market gardening and horticulture specialise in the cultivation of high-value crops such as vegetables, fruits, and flowers for urban markets. Mixed farming involves a balance of crops and animal husbandry, dairy farming focuses on milch animals, and Mediterranean agriculture is a type of specialised farming in the Mediterranean region. Hence, the correct answer is Market Gardening and Horticulture.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कृषि का प्रकार है जिसमें शहरी बाजारों के लिए उच्च मूल्य वाले फसलों जैसे सब्जियां, फल और फूलों की खेती शामिल है?
hi.solution: बाजार के बागान और बागवानी उच्च मूल्य वाले फसलों जैसे सब्जियां, फल और फूलों की खेती करती हैं जो शहरी बाजारों के लिए होती हैं। मिश्रित कृषि में फसलों और पशुपालन का संतुलन होता है, डेयरी कृषि दुग्ध उत्पादन पर केंद्रित होती है, और मध्यसागरीय कृषि मध्यसागरीय क्षेत्र में विशिष्ट कृषि का एक प्रकार है। इसलिए सही उत्तर बाजार के बागान और बागवानी है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All options and the solution are correctly translated, with the correct answer remaining in the same position. The technical terms used are standard in Hindi educational materials.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते शेतीचे प्रकार उच्च मूल्याच्या पिकांच्या लागवडीसाठी असते जे शहरी बाजारांसाठी असतात?

questions.stem: Which type of farming is practised mainly near urban and industrial centres where there is a market for fresh milk and dairy products?
questions.solution: Dairy farming is practised mainly near urban and industrial centres where there is a market for fresh milk and dairy products. Market gardening and horticulture focus on high-value crops for urban markets, Mediterranean agriculture is a specialised form of farming, and mixed farming involves a balance of crops and animal husbandry. Hence, the correct answer is Dairy Farming.

hi.stem: कौन सा कृषि प्रकार शहरी एवं औद्योगिक केंद्रों के पास मुख्य रूप से अपनाया जाता है जहां ताजा दूध एवं डेयरी उत्पादों के लिए बाजार होता है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a speciality of the Mediterranean region?
questions.solution: Viticulture, or grape cultivation, is a speciality of the Mediterranean region. Rice transplantation and tea plantation are not specific to the Mediterranean region, and dairy farming is a general type of farming. Hence, the correct answer is Viticulture.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा मध्य सागरीय क्षेत्र की विशेषता है?
hi.solution: अंगूर के कृषि, या अंगूर की खेती मध्य सागरीय क्षेत्र की एक विशेषता है। चावल के बीज बोना और चाय के बागान मध्य सागरीय क्षेत्र के लिए विशिष्ट नहीं हैं, और दुग्ध कृषि एक सामान्य प्रकार की कृषि है। इसलिए सही उत्तर अंगूर के कृषि है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate regional terminology.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते मध्यप्राच्य विस्ताराचे विशेषत्व आहे?

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the primary activity of gathering?
choices: It involves the extraction of resources from the ocean
It is the act of cutting down trees for timber
It refers to the collection of plants and animals for sustenance
It is the process of extracting and processing raw materials from the earth
questions.solution: The correct option is the collection of plants and animals for sustenance, as gathering typically involves collecting natural resources directly for survival. Extracting resources from the ocean refers to fishing, cutting down trees is forestry, and extracting raw materials from the earth is mining, none of which align with the direct collection of food and materials for immediate use.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of mixed farming?
choices: It focuses exclusively on animal husbandry.
It combines crop cultivation and animal husbandry.
It is based on a single type of crop or animal.
questions.solution: Mixed farming combines crop cultivation and animal husbandry, allowing for a balanced and sustainable agricultural system. The other options are incorrect because they describe farming systems that focus on only one aspect, such as crops or animals, rather than the integration of both.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a co-operative movement in agriculture?
choices: A group of farmers working together to sell their produce
A large corporation owning a farm
A private company managing a farm
questions.solution: A co-operative movement in agriculture involves individuals working together for mutual benefit. A group of farmers working together to sell their produce exemplifies this, as they share resources and goals. A large corporation, government-run project, or private company managing a farm does not reflect the collaborative nature of a co-operative.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of commercial livestock rearing?
choices: Planting rice in small plots for family consumption
Raising sheep in a large fenced area for meat and wool production
Clearing forest land to grow crops for local use
Using traditional tools to cultivate land for subsistence
questions.solution: Commercial livestock rearing is organised and capital-intensive, involving large areas and scientific methods. Raising sheep in a large fenced area for meat and wool matches this description.
